sentences.en: A woman lived alone in a small home.
sentences.tgt: Une:o femme:n vivait:v seule:a dans:o une:o petite:a maison:n .:o

sentences.en: The woman wanted to have a little child.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n voulait:v avoir:v un:o petit:a enfant:n .:o

sentences.en: One day, she went to see an old witch.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o elle:o alla:v voir:v une:o vieille:a sorcière:n .:o

sentences.en: "Please give me a child," the woman said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Donnez-moi:v un:o enfant:n ,:o je:o vous:o en:o prie:v »:o ,:o dit:v la:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: The witch listened and gave her a small seed.
sentences.tgt: La:o sorcière:n écouta:v et:o lui:o donna:v une:o petite:a graine:n .:o

sentences.en: "Put this seed in a pot by the window," said the witch.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mettez:v cette:o graine:n dans:o un:o pot:n près:o de:o la:o fenêtre:n »:o ,:o dit:v la:o sorcière:n .:o

sentences.en: "A flower will grow from this seed," she said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Une:o fleur:n poussera:v de:o cette:o graine:n »:o ,:o dit-elle:v .:o

sentences.en: The woman thanked the witch and went home.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n remercia:v la:o sorcière:n et:o rentra:v chez:o elle:o .:o

sentences.en: She put the seed in a pot by the window.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o mit:v la:o graine:n dans:o un:o pot:n près:o de:o la:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: She gave it water every morning and every night.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o lui:o donnait:v de:o l':o eau:n chaque:o matin:n et:o chaque:o soir:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon a green plant grew, and a large bud sat on it.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a une:o plante:n verte:a poussa:v ,:o et:o un:o grand:a bourgeon:n s':o posa:v dessus:o .:o

sentences.en: The woman looked at the dark red bud every day.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n regardait:v le:o bourgeon:n rouge:a foncé:a chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: One morning, the red bud opened in the warm sun.
sentences.tgt: Un:o matin:n ,:o le:o bourgeon:n rouge:a s':o ouvrit:v dans:o le:o soleil:n chaud:a .:o

sentences.en: In the flower sat a tiny girl.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o fleur:n était:v assise:a une:o toute:a petite:a fille:n .:o

sentences.en: She was as small as the woman's thumb.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o était:v aussi:a petite:a que:o le:o pouce:n de:o la:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: "My pretty girl!" said the woman.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ma:o jolie:a fille:n !:o »:o dit:v -elle:o .:o

sentences.en: The woman named her Thumbelina.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n la:o nomma:v Thumbelina:o .:o

sentences.en: She made Thumbelina a little bed from a walnut shell.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o lui:o fit:v un:o petit:a lit:n à:o partir:v d':o une:o coquille:n de:o noix:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina slept in the shell by the window.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o dormait:v dans:o la:o coquille:n près:o de:o la:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: Soft petals covered her at night.
sentences.tgt: De:o doux:a pétales:n la:o couvraient:v la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: Every morning, Thumbelina sang in the sun by the window.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o matin:n ,:o Thumbelina:o chantait:v au:o soleil:n près:o de:o la:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: On warm nights, the woman left the window open.
sentences.tgt: Les:o nuits:n chaudes:a ,:o la:o femme:n laissait:v la:o fenêtre:n ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina looked at the dark sky from her shell.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o regarda:v le:o ciel:n sombre:a depuis:o sa:o coquille:n .:o

sentences.en: One night, an old toad came in at the open window.
sentences.tgt: Une:o nuit:n ,:o un:o vieux:a crapaud:n entra:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: The old toad looked at the pretty girl.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a crapaud:n regarda:v la:o jolie:a fille:n .:o

sentences.en: The toad wanted a wife for her son.
sentences.tgt: Le:o crapaud:n voulait:v une:o femme:n pour:o son:o fils:n .:o

sentences.en: She took the walnut shell with Thumbelina in it.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o prit:v la:o coquille:n de:o noix:n avec:o Thumbelina:o dedans:o .:o

sentences.en: The toad hopped away into the dark night.
sentences.tgt: Le:o crapaud:n sauta:v dans:o la:o nuit:n sombre:a .:o

sentences.en: The old toad carried her away to a stream.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a crapaud:n l':o emporta:v jusqu':o à:o un:o ruisseau:n .:o

sentences.en: She put the shell on a lily pad in the water.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o posa:v la:o coquille:n sur:o un:o nénuphar:n dans:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning, Thumbelina woke up on the lily pad.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o Thumbelina:o se:o réveilla:v sur:o le:o nénuphar:n .:o

sentences.en: Water was all around the lily pad.
sentences.tgt: L':o eau:n était:v tout:a autour:o du:o nénuphar:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina could not get back to the land.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o retourner:v sur:o la:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: The old toad came back with her son.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a crapaud:n revint:v avec:o son:o fils:n .:o

sentences.en: "Croak, croak," was all the son could say.
sentences.tgt: «:o Coâ:o ,:o coâ:o »:o était:v tout:o ce:o que:o le:o fils:n pouvait:v dire:v .:o

sentences.en: "You will live with my son in the mud," said the toad.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o vivras:v avec:o mon:o fils:n dans:o la:o boue:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o crapaud:n .:o

sentences.en: The toads hopped away to make a home in the mud.
sentences.tgt: Les:o crapauds:n sautèrent:v pour:o faire:v un:o nid:n dans:o la:o boue:n .:o

sentences.en: She began to cry in the morning sun.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o commença:v à:o pleurer:v sous:o le:o soleil:n du:o matin:n .:o

sentences.en: She did not want to live in the mud with the son.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o vivre:v dans:o la:o boue:n avec:o le:o fils:n .:o

sentences.en: Little fish swam in the stream by the lily pad.
sentences.tgt: De:o petits:a poissons:n nageaient:v dans:o le:o ruisseau:n près:o du:o nénuphar:n .:o

sentences.en: The fish heard Thumbelina cry all day.
sentences.tgt: Les:o poissons:n entendirent:v Thumbelina:o pleurer:v toute:a la:o journée:n .:o

sentences.en: "She should not live with the ugly toad," said one fish.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o ne:o devrait:v pas:o vivre:v avec:o le:o vilain:a crapaud:n ,:o »:o dit:v un:o poisson:n .:o

sentences.en: The little fish began to bite the green stem of the pad.
sentences.tgt: Le:o petit:a poisson:n commença:v à:o mordre:v la:o tige:n verte:a du:o nénuphar:n .:o

sentences.en: They bit the stem again and again.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o mordirent:v la:o tige:n encore:a et:o encore:a .:o

sentences.en: Soon the stem broke free from the mud.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a la:o tige:n se:o détacha:v de:o la:o boue:n .:o

sentences.en: The lily pad floated away down the stream.
sentences.tgt: Le:o nénuphar:n flotta:v au:o loin:a sur:o le:o ruisseau:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina thanked the little fish and smiled.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o remercia:v les:o petits:a poissons:n et:o sourit:v .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina floated on the lily pad for a long time.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o flotta:v sur:o le:o nénuphar:n pendant:o un:o long:a moment:n .:o

sentences.en: The sun went down, and night came to the water.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soleil:n se:o coucha:v ,:o et:o la:o nuit:n vint:v sur:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: In the morning, a beetle saw her from a tall tree.
sentences.tgt: Le:o matin:n ,:o un:o scarabée:n la:o vit:v depuis:o un:o grand:a arbre:n .:o

sentences.en: He flew down to the lily pad.
sentences.tgt: Il:o vola:v jusqu':o au:o nénuphar:n .:o

sentences.en: The beetle took Thumbelina up into the tall tree.
sentences.tgt: Le:o scarabée:n emporta:v Thumbelina:o en:o haut:a dans:o le:o grand:a arbre:n .:o

sentences.en: The beetle thought Thumbelina was pretty.
sentences.tgt: Le:o scarabée:n pensait:v que:o Thumbelina:o était:v jolie:a .:o

sentences.en: Other beetles came to look at the tiny girl.
sentences.tgt: D':o autres:a scarabées:n vinrent:v regarder:v la:o petite:a fille:n .:o

sentences.en: "She has only two legs," said one beetle.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o n':o a:v que:o deux:o jambes:n ,:o »:o dit:v un:o scarabée:n .:o

sentences.en: "She has no feelers," said the other beetles.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o n':o a:v pas:o d':o antennes:n ,:o »:o dirent:v les:o autres:a scarabées:n .:o

sentences.en: "She is not pretty at all," they all said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Elle:o n':o est:v pas:o jolie:a du:o tout:a ,:o »:o dirent:v -ils:o tous:a .:o

sentences.en: He did not want Thumbelina now.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o voulait:v plus:o Thumbelina:o maintenant:a .:o

sentences.en: The beetle flew down and put her on a daisy.
sentences.tgt: Le:o scarabée:n descendit:v et:o la:o posa:v sur:o une:o marguerite:n .:o

sentences.en: He flew away and left her all alone.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o envola:v et:o la:o laissa:v toute:a seule:a .:o

sentences.en: All summer, Thumbelina lived alone in the green woods.
sentences.tgt: Tout:a l':o été:n ,:o Thumbelina:o vécut:v seule:a dans:o les:o bois:n verts:a .:o

sentences.en: She made a small bed of petals under the daisy.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o fit:v un:o petit:a lit:n de:o pétales:n sous:o la:o marguerite:n .:o

sentences.en: She lived on the water from the flowers every day.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o vivait:v de:o l':o eau:n des:o fleurs:n chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: A swallow sang in a tree over her.
sentences.tgt: Une:o hirondelle:n chanta:v dans:o un:o arbre:n au-dessus:o d':o elle:o .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina loved to hear the swallow sing every day.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o aimait:v entendre:v l':o hirondelle:n chanter:v chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: She was happy, but she thought of the woman at home.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o était:v heureuse:a ,:o mais:o elle:o pensait:v à:o la:o femme:n à:o la:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon the days turned cold in the woods.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a les:o jours:n devinrent:v froids:a dans:o les:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: The leaves turned yellow and fell to the ground.
sentences.tgt: Les:o feuilles:n devinrent:v jaunes:a et:o tombèrent:v à:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: Snow began to fall from the dark sky.
sentences.tgt: La:o neige:n commença:v à:o tomber:v du:o ciel:n sombre:a .:o

sentences.en: The snow covered the ground and all the flowers.
sentences.tgt: La:o neige:n couvrit:v le:o sol:n et:o toutes:o les:o fleurs:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina was cold, and she had no warm home now.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o avait:v froid:n ,:o et:o elle:o n':o avait:v plus:o de:o maison:n chaude:a maintenant:a .:o

sentences.en: She could not keep her small bed warm in the snow.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o garder:v son:o petit:a lit:n chaud:a dans:o la:o neige:n .:o

sentences.en: She looked for a warm home under the ground.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o chercha:v une:o maison:n chaude:a sous:o la:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: At last, she came to a little hole in the ground.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:o ,:o elle:o arriva:v à:o un:o petit:a trou:n dans:o le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: A field mouse lived in the warm hole under the ground.
sentences.tgt: Un:o mulot:n vivait:v dans:o le:o trou:n chaud:a sous:o la:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: "Please give me a little food," said Thumbelina.
sentences.tgt: «:o Donnez-moi:v -moi:o s':o il:o vous:o plaît:v un:o peu:a de:o nourriture:n »:o ,:o dit:v Thumbelina:o .:o

sentences.en: "I have had no food for two days."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o ai:v pas:o mangé:v depuis:o deux:o jours:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Come in and get warm," said the kind field mouse.
sentences.tgt: «:o Entrez:v et:o réchauffez-vous:v »:o ,:o dit:v le:o gentil:a mulot:n .:o

sentences.en: The field mouse gave her food and a warm bed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o mulot:n lui:o donna:v de:o la:o nourriture:n et:o un:o lit:n chaud:a .:o

sentences.en: "You may stay here with me for the winter," said the mouse.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o pouvez:v rester:v ici:a avec:o moi:o pour:o l':o hiver:n »:o ,:o dit:v le:o mulot:n .:o

sentences.en: "But you must keep my home and sing for me."
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o vous:o devez:v entretenir:v ma:o maison:n et:o chanter:v pour:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina thanked the kind field mouse.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o remercia:v le:o gentil:a mulot:n .:o

sentences.en: She kept the little home warm all winter.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o garda:v la:o petite:a maison:n chaude:a tout:o l':o hiver:n .:o

sentences.en: Every morning, Thumbelina sang for the field mouse.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o matin:n ,:o Thumbelina:o chantait:v pour:o le:o mulot:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina thought of the sun and the flowers.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o pensait:v au:o soleil:n et:o aux:o fleurs:n .:o

sentences.en: The field mouse had a rich neighbor, an old mole.
sentences.tgt: La:o souris:n des:o champs:n avait:v un:o riche:a voisin:n ,:o une:o vieille:a taupe:n .:o

sentences.en: The mole lived under the ground and did not love the sun.
sentences.tgt: La:o taupe:n vivait:v sous:o la:o terre:n et:o n':o aimait:v pas:o le:o soleil:n .:o

sentences.en: One day, the mole came to see the mouse.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o la:o taupe:n vint:v rendre:v visite:n à:o la:o souris:n .:o

sentences.en: "Sing for my neighbor," said the field mouse.
sentences.tgt: «:o Chante:v pour:o mon:o voisin:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o souris:n des:o champs:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina sang for the mole in her soft voice.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o chanta:v pour:o la:o taupe:n de:o sa:o voix:n douce:a .:o

sentences.en: The mole loved her voice and wanted Thumbelina for his wife.
sentences.tgt: La:o taupe:n aimait:v sa:o voix:n et:o voulait:v Thumbelina:o pour:o sa:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: "You should marry the rich mole," the mouse said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o devrais:v épouser:v la:o riche:a taupe:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o souris:n .:o

sentences.en: The mole made a long tunnel under the ground.
sentences.tgt: La:o taupe:n creusa:v un:o long:a tunnel:n sous:o la:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: One day, he took Thumbelina into the dark tunnel.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o il:o emmena:v Thumbelina:o dans:o le:o sombre:a tunnel:n .:o

sentences.en: A bird was down on the ground in the tunnel.
sentences.tgt: Un:o oiseau:n était:v tombé:a par:o terre:n dans:o le:o tunnel:n .:o

sentences.en: It was a swallow, cold and still.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o hirondelle:n ,:o froide:a et:o immobile:a .:o

sentences.en: "I do not love birds," said the mole.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o n':o aime:v pas:o les:o oiseaux:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o taupe:n .:o

sentences.en: He went on into the dark.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o enfonça:v dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: But Thumbelina thought of the swallow that sang in the summer.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Thumbelina:o pensa:v à:o l':o hirondelle:n qui:o chantait:v en:o été:n .:o

sentences.en: At night, Thumbelina went back to the tunnel all alone.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n ,:o Thumbelina:o retourna:v seule:a au:o tunnel:n .:o

sentences.en: She covered the cold swallow with hay.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o couvrit:v l':o hirondelle:n froide:a de:o foin:n .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina felt the swallow, and it was a little warm.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o toucha:v l':o hirondelle:n ,:o et:o elle:o était:v un:o peu:a chaude:a .:o

sentences.en: The swallow was not dead at all.
sentences.tgt: L':o hirondelle:n n':o était:v pas:o morte:a du:o tout:a .:o

sentences.en: All that winter, Thumbelina took hay and water to the swallow.
sentences.tgt: Tout:o cet:o hiver:n ,:o Thumbelina:o apporta:v du:o foin:n et:o de:o l':o eau:n à:o l':o hirondelle:n .:o

sentences.en: She kept the swallow a secret from the mole.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o cacha:v l':o hirondelle:n à:o la:o taupe:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon the swallow was strong again.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a l':o hirondelle:n fut:v de:o nouveau:a forte:a .:o

sentences.en: Warm winds came, and spring came back to the fields.
sentences.tgt: Des:o vents:n chauds:a vinrent:v ,:o et:o le:o printemps:n revint:v dans:o les:o champs:n .:o

sentences.en: The swallow could fly again in the spring.
sentences.tgt: L':o hirondelle:n pouvait:v voler:v de:o nouveau:a au:o printemps:n .:o

sentences.en: "Thank you for the hay and the water," said the swallow.
sentences.tgt: «:o Merci:n pour:o le:o foin:n et:o l':o eau:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o hirondelle:n .:o

sentences.en: "Come away with me to a warm land," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Viens:v avec:o moi:o dans:o un:o pays:n chaud:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina wanted to go away and see that warm land.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o voulait:v partir:v et:o voir:v ce:o pays:n chaud:a .:o

sentences.en: But she thought of the kind field mouse and her warm home.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o elle:o pensa:v à:o la:o gentille:a souris:n des:o champs:n et:o à:o sa:o maison:n chaleureuse:a .:o

sentences.en: "I will not leave her now," Thumbelina said to the swallow.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o la:o quitterai:v pas:o maintenant:a ,:o »:o dit:v Thumbelina:o à:o l':o hirondelle:n .:o

sentences.en: The swallow flew away all alone into the spring sky.
sentences.tgt: L':o hirondelle:n s':o envola:v seule:a dans:o le:o ciel:n du:o printemps:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon the field mouse wanted a wedding for the fall.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a la:o souris:n des:o champs:n voulut:v un:o mariage:n pour:o l':o automne:n .:o

sentences.en: "You will marry the mole in the fall," said the mouse.
sentences.tgt: «:o Tu:o épouseras:v la:o taupe:n en:o automne:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o souris:n .:o

sentences.en: The days turned cold, and the leaves turned yellow again.
sentences.tgt: Les:o jours:n devinrent:v froids:a ,:o et:o les:o feuilles:n redevinrent:v jaunes:a .:o

sentences.en: The wedding day came at last.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n du:o mariage:n arriva:v enfin:a .:o

sentences.en: The field mouse made Thumbelina a wedding dress.
sentences.tgt: La:o souris:n des:o champs:n fit:v à:o Thumbelina:o une:o robe:n de:o mariée:n .:o

sentences.en: "You will live with the mole under the ground," said the mouse.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o vivrez:v avec:o la:o taupe:n sous:o la:o terre:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o souris:n .:o

sentences.en: But Thumbelina did not want to live down under the ground.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Thumbelina:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o vivre:v sous:o la:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: "Could I go out and see the sun one last time?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourrais:v -je:o sortir:v et:o voir:v le:o soleil:n une:o dernière:a fois:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: The field mouse said yes.
sentences.tgt: La:o souris:n des:o champs:n dit:v oui:o .:o

sentences.en: Thumbelina went out and looked up at the warm sun.
sentences.tgt: Thumbelina:o sortit:v et:o leva:v les:o yeux:n vers:o le:o soleil:n chaud:a .:o

sentences.en: She heard the swallow, and he flew down to her.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o entendit:v l':o hirondelle:n ,:o et:o il:o descendit:v vers:o elle:o .:o

sentences.en: "I will marry the mole," she said to the swallow.

sentences.en: "Come away with me to the warm land," said the swallow.

sentences.en: Then she got on the swallow's back, and they flew away.

sentences.en: "Will you stay here and be my wife?" asked the prince.
